value.rationale: The nearest and farthest vertex Euclidean squared distances are canonical geometric proximity and covering quantities for uniform points in a regular simplex. The exact all-dimensional signed covariance and sharp logarithmic correlation decay distinguish a finite-dependence effect invisible in established marginal Gaussian and extreme-value limit laws, making the precise invariant naturally motivated and reusable in stochastic geometry.
